daily.title: Birds cause a flutter of discontent for Medvedev at US Open
daily.summary: Daniil Medvedev was left flustered when two birds hopped onto the net during his US Open victory against Sebastian Gorzny, but he overcame the disruption to claim victory.

daily.title: Live: Hadley back in the witness box for a third day, as Jones trial resumes
daily.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

daily.title: LA Clippers fined $40m over 'flagrant' rules breaches
daily.summary: The NBA suspends LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer and fines the team $41.5 million for "flagrant violations" of the salary cap rules, with Kawhi Leonard also fined.

daily.title: Pro-stadium opinion piece by public servant had input from Devils footy club
daily.summary: When a 3,000-word opinion piece by a senior public servant appeared in a major daily newspaper, eyebrows were raised across Tasmania's political spectrum. Emails show the pro-stadium piece had extensive involvement by multiple groups with stakes in the project.

daily.title: Insurance delays as Exmouth residents struggle with living conditions
daily.summary: Five months after Cyclone Narelle caused damages to properties in Exmouth, locals are still struggling to have their insurance claims processed to start repairs for their homes.

daily.title: Warwick Thornton enters Red CentreNATS with 'Michelangelo of the bush'
daily.summary: Acclaimed Alice Springs filmmaker Warwick Thornton is also a diehard rev head and amateur mechanic who loves old cars — and he's making his Red CentreNATS debut this year with a lovingly restored 1970s Toyota FJ 40 "bull chaser".

daily.title: Hampshire ditches New Zealand all-rounder after fan backlash
daily.summary: Hampshire released a statement saying the club had "listened to feedback from our staff and supporters" following the signing of Scott Kuggeleijn.

daily.title: $12m koala underpass not used in five months
daily.summary: Conservationists hope koalas will start using the first koala underpass south of Sydney despite research suggesting the native animal rarely uses them.

daily.title: Sydney's gangland war marks another tragic chapter
daily.summary: Bungled assassinations and death by association have become more frequent in Sydney's underworld war as a potential sixth innocent victim is killed in the past 18 months.

daily.title: Golfers despair as rabbits damage one of Australia's best courses
daily.summary: There are fears out-of-control rabbits and the unexpected holes they keep adding to the greens will threaten the legacy of one of the oldest golf courses in Western Australia.

daily.title: Aviation authorities to review low flyover at Cape Town rugby match
daily.summary: South African authorities confirm they are reviewing a flyover during a rugby match against New Zealand that saw two jets perilously close to the stadium roof.

daily.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
daily.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: They used to be a tourist's first stop in town, now their future is uncertain
daily.summary: The buildings with the well-known bright yellow "i" have welcomed road trippers and tourists for years, but more visitor information centres are closing their doors.

daily.title: Coalition unveils plan to slash tobacco tax by $24 a pack
daily.summary: A future Coalition government would slash the tobacco excise by 80 per cent, legalise and tax vapes and nicotine pouches, and bolster law enforcement to shut down the illicit trade.

daily.title: Prime-time era Magbegor leads Opals' World Cup charge
daily.summary: The Opals' superstar production line will be led by Ezi Magbegor at the Women's Basketball World Cup, as they look to emulate the historic gold medal won by the team 20 years ago.

daily.title: More Aussies tumble as de Minaur finally concludes first round match
daily.summary: Taylah Preston and Daria Kasatkina bow out of the US Open as Alex de Minaur's campaign is delayed by rain again.

daily.title: Fierce division over highly flammable grass pastoralists rely on
daily.summary: Buffel grass is thriving and spreading across South Australia, increasing the risk of bushfires. But not everyone agrees on how to manage it.

daily.title: Profitable thrift store using 'smoke screen' to appear charitable, critics say
daily.summary: Op shops are feeling threatened as Savers expands its second-hand retail stores across Australia.

daily.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
daily.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.

daily.title: Student misbehaviour damaging teacher health, teachers say
daily.summary: A survey of about 400 teachers finds classroom disruption has a significant negative effect on the health of teachers, with female teachers the most affected.

daily.title: 'Grossly inadequate': NT traditional owners plan to mandate mine rehabilitation
daily.summary: Traditional owners in the NT want to see more money put aside for the rehabilitation of closed mines and are considering making it a requirement of any agreement established between mine companies and traditional owners.

daily.title: Farmer aims to be first to swim length of Darling River
daily.summary: A Victorian farmer has made it his mission to become the first person to swim the 1,650 kilometres of Australia's second-longest river.

daily.title: Hydro Tasmania assures state has energy as fire guts major power station
daily.summary: Emergency crews have contained a fire at Tungatinah Power Station and an investigation is set to be launched.

daily.title: Whyalla nervously waits for steelworks sale, blast furnace fix
daily.summary: South Australia's treasurer has hinted Whyalla may have to wait longer for the identity of its steelworks buyer, as locals tell the ABC recent events are bringing back old memories.

daily.title: Australia is facing a 'looming crisis' as people enter retirement as lifelong renters
daily.summary: More people are edging towards retirement as "forever renters". They are making tough decisions about work, where to live and how they will afford to retire.

developing.title: Live: ASX falls sharply, oil hits two-month high amid US-Iran strikes
developing.summary: The Australian share market is recording heavy losses after the US launched fresh strikes against Iran, driving oil prices up and contributing to a global bond sell-off. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.
